name: American Plastic Molding Corporation
old_description: See first hand how APM can help you develop a better injection molded part or plastic molded product
about:
American Plastic Molding Corporation (APM) is based in Scottsburg, Indiana. The company was founded in 1971 and has been employee-owned and operated since its inception. It began as a basic injection molder and over five decades expanded into a full-service manufacturing and product development organization.

APM provides injection molding, finished-goods assembly, engineering, tooling, and supply-chain management. Its 50,000-square-foot production area houses 42 injection-molding machines ranging from 100 to 900 tons, capable of shot sizes from 0.015 to 116 ounces. A 15,000-square-foot assembly space runs LEAN cells for mechanical and electro-mechanical assemblies, and a 7,500-square-foot climate-controlled mold shop includes high-speed CNC machining centers and four-axis EDMs. The company employs about 120 people and reports roughly $20 million in annual sales.

APM serves customers in industries that require compliance with standards such as BIFMA (furniture), UL (electrical), and automotive-related regulations including IMDS, RoHS, and REACH. Its supply-chain services cover both domestic and offshore sourcing, vendor-managed inventory, and drop-shipment programs.

The company emphasizes five core values—integrity, purpose, teamwork, perseverance, and gratitude—and positions itself around "product realization," combining design assistance, mold-flow analysis, VA/VE engineering, and rapid prototyping with 24-hour emergency mold repair.
